visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with light brown hair in a ponytail and a blue-and-white striped shirt stands in a bright, modern white kitchen. She speaks to the camera while gesturing toward a white VOTO steam air fryer sitting on a wooden-accented counter behind her. The background features a white refrigerator and minimalist cabinetry under warm indoor lighting. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of the VOTO appliance, emphasizing its sleek white finish and digital control panel. A hand is shown pointing at the water tank attached to the back of the device and the transparent glass door at the front. (3) Close-up shots focus on the digital interface, where various cooking modes like 'Toast', 'Pizza', and 'Chicken Wings' are displayed in Traditional Chinese text. A hand interacts with a central dial, showing the adjustment of temperature and time. (4) Several shots demonstrate the appliance in use, showing food items like salmon fillets, steaks, and steamed buns inside on stainless steel racks. The lighting inside the oven illuminates the cooking process. (5) The video highlights various accessories including a rotisserie spit, a mesh basket for air frying, and a flat wire rack. These are shown being held up to the camera and placed into the oven tiers. (6) A maintenance segment features close-ups of a water tank being handled to explain a sealing mechanism, followed by a screen recording of a social media profile. (7) The video concludes with the woman returning to the frame, summarizing the promotion while standing next to the product in the kitchen setting.
